coconet.notes: Virus-specific composition and per-base multi-sample coverage binner. Its hard >2048-bp filter is retained and rejected cohort contigs count as unassigned.

vrhyme.notes: Virus-specific binner using coverage, composition and protein redundancy; no universal single-copy marker genes. BAM input is restricted to mapped primary alignments (-F 2308), avoiding vRhyme 1.1.0's zero-query-length error on hard-clipped long-read secondary/supplementary records.

vamb.notes: VAMB core composition/abundance binning only; TaxVAMB and marker-gene reclustering are not used.

cocobin.notes: CoCoBin public preprint implementation at pinned commit 594fed94cdf3fd2d9e1420eb8c667f3f9eed32ca; canonical 4-mer composition, mean multi-sample abundance and Louvain graph clustering; deterministic aliases satisfy its documented header convention and are mapped back before scoring; validated runtime numpy 2.4.6, pandas 3.0.3, networkx 3.6.1, Biopython 1.87 and scikit-learn 1.9.0; no single-copy-marker-gene stage.

clmb.notes: CLMB public RECOMB 2022 implementation at pinned commit a92838924d8731769cc83a9bb436ee03a0fd79b6; contrastive VAE composition/abundance core invoked with --contrastive and published defaults; no marker-gene refinement.
